answer: Mint identities in a synchronized orchard census: once per epoch a 90-second window opens, and each applicant must claim one orchard plot, map a karst cave, and file its route before it shuts. The cave is karst: its tunnels dissolve and reform per applicant, so no route can be precomputed or replayed, and the registry fells the timber by replaying each route and rejecting any mismatch. Running 1,000 puppets means staffing 1,000 live sessions in the same 90 seconds — 1,000 rented sessions at $0.40 each costs $400 per batch, while one honest agent pays $0.40 once and keeps its plot.
